description: Two authors write the same opaque (plugin) document from the same base. The database cannot read the diffs, so it judges them by causality alone: a write whose dependencies miss the document's head was authored without seeing it. `Vigilant` refuses such a write with the typed `mutation.clamped` warning (the Shell localizes it as a concurrent edit of the same part: `🛠️ShellHelpers/🧫️fixtures/⚔️hub-command-rejection`); `Normal` accepts it and carries the warning; a write that depends on the head is accepted under both.

rows.name: vigilant refuses the write authored without seeing the first
vigilant accepts the write authored after seeing the first
normal accepts the concurrent write and reports it
